paragraphs.source_en: And he seized Marius’ head, and pressed it with both arms against his breast, and both fell to weeping. This is one of the forms of supreme happiness. “Father!” cried Marius. “Ah, so you love me!” said the old man. An ineffable moment ensued. They were choking and could not speak. At length the old man stammered: “Come! his mouth is unstopped at last.
